content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    林逸有些嗤之以鼻，别说狗了，在深山执行任务的时候多少只狼都被自己一掌拍死打了牙祭，一条罗威纳自然不在话下。
“看到了吧？这就是威武将军，告诉你，他可是很厉害的哦，你要是敢上楼去，我就叫它咬死你！”
楚梦瑶威吓道。
“知道了。”
林逸点了点头。
看到林逸那小心翼翼的样子，楚梦瑶还以为他怕了威武将军呢，心下更加得意。
拉着陈雨舒跑上了楼去，留着威武将军在楼梯口把守着。
林逸拎起地上的行李，瞪了威武将军一眼，威武将军浑身一哆嗦，向后躲了躲，它似乎也感觉到了面前的人不一般，是个危险人物。
林逸也没有闲心和狗玩儿，瞪了它一眼之后，就不再理他，拎着行李来到了之前楚梦瑶说的那间房里。
房间里面装修的很简单，只有一张床，一张写字台和一个小衣柜。
不过，这些东西已经足够林逸用了，他带来的行李只有几件破衣服，其他什么都没有。
最让林逸赶到惊讶的是，房间里居然有独立的洗手间，简直就和大宾馆一样！
林逸将自己的行李放好，然后拿着毛巾走进洗手间，这一路的奔波，让林逸的身上沾满了灰尘。
看了看表，现在不到六点，趁着福伯来送饭之前，林逸打算洗个澡。
至此为止，林逸对目前的工作以及工作环境还是很满意的，天天住宾馆一样的待遇，还能拿三万块钱，这工作哪里找去呀？
比在家帮着老头子编草鞋惬意多了。
“小舒，我有些后悔了，这个林逸看起来怎么也不像是个能做我挡箭牌的人呀？”
楚梦瑶换了一套家居服，对陈雨舒抱怨道。
“喔，我看他挺好。”
陈雨舒躺在床上，将双腿倒立着靠在墙上，她不知道从哪里看到说，这样可以瘦腿，还能促进发育。

“好什么呀，本来，我还想着，找个帅帅的来冒充我的男朋友，现在倒好了，弄个土老帽来，带出去还不被人笑死呀！”
楚梦瑶气得直咬牙：“你要是觉得他好，你给他做女朋友得了。”
“喔，我又没有麻烦，不需要挡箭牌的。不然的话，我还真没准儿会考虑一下呢。”
陈雨舒摇头晃脑的说道。
“你有个做厉害的哥哥，谁敢招惹你？我要是有个一脚能将大树踢断的哥哥，我也不用找什么挡箭牌了！”
楚梦瑶知道陈雨舒是故意气自己呢，不过谁让人家有个哥哥，自己没有呢？
“瑶瑶姐，要不，我叫我哥哥在部队里给你找个干哥哥？”
陈雨舒眨了眨眼：“要不情哥哥也行……那钟品亮还不乖乖的靠边站？”
“小舒！”
楚梦瑶听陈雨舒越说越没谱了，顿时气得瞪大了眼睛：
“你出的都是什么馊主意啊！之前说叫我父亲给我找个挡箭牌，结果……你看看，找来个什么人？他能给当挡箭牌么？现在你又给我出这么个鬼主意，还什么情哥哥，难听死了！”
“喔，好了好了，我不说了就是。”
陈雨舒见楚梦瑶真的发怒了，赶紧闭上了嘴巴，不敢再说下去。
的确，找个挡箭牌的主意是她给楚梦瑶出的，结果现在找来的人不合心意，她也有一定的责任……
福伯来送晚饭的时候，林逸也刚刚洗过澡，翻了翻行李，居然一件像样的衣服也没有。
林逸不由得抱怨老头子实在是抠门，就不能给自己买一件新衣服么？
估计自己穿这些衣服，出去以后照样会被楚梦瑶认为是脏衣服，连沙发都坐不上。
没办法，林逸随手将福伯给他的包林逸的新形象让楚梦瑶和陈雨舒都为之一愣！
之前蓬头垢面的，穿着破背心子大裤头，现在洗过澡之后，却显得斯斯文文，再配上学校的校服，倒是和之前的民工形象判若两人！
不过，对林逸的第一印象实在是太差了点儿，所以楚梦瑶怎么也不会承认林逸是个帅哥，只能说他比之前要强一些顺眼一些而已。

福伯送来了四菜一汤，一道鱼香肉丝、一道水煮鱼、一道清炒小白菜、一道菠菜烧木耳。汤是松茸汤。
荤素搭配，色香味俱全。
林逸好久都没有吃到这么美味的饭菜了，见福伯也准备了他的米饭盒，愉快的接了过来坐在了餐桌上。
林逸刚想动筷子，楚梦瑶就不愿意了：“你干什么，我和小舒都还没吃呢，你就先吃？以后我和小舒先吃，不吃的菜你再吃！”

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Lin Yi sneered. Let alone dogs, many wolves were slapped to death by him while performing tasks in the mountains, and a Rottweiler was certainly not an exception.
"Did you see it? This is General Mighty. Let me tell you, he is very powerful. If you dare to go upstairs, I will ask him to bite you to death!"
Chu Mengyao threatened.
"Got it."
Lin Yi nodded.
Seeing Lin Yi's cautious look, Chu Mengyao thought he was afraid of the mighty general, and felt even more proud.
He pulled Chen Yushu and ran upstairs, leaving the mighty general guarding the stairs.
Lin Yi picked up the luggage on the ground and glared at General Mighty. General Mighty shivered and hid back. It seemed to sense that the person in front of it was unusual and dangerous.
Lin Yi didn't have time to play with the dog. After glaring at it, he ignored him and carried his luggage to the room Chu Mengyao mentioned before.
The room is very simply decorated, with only a bed, a writing desk and a small wardrobe.
However, these things were enough for Lin Yi. The luggage he brought only had a few rags and nothing else.
What surprised Lin Yi the most was that there was a separate bathroom in the room, just like a big hotel!
Lin Yi put away his luggage and then walked into the bathroom with a towel. Lin Yi's body was covered with dust from running around.
Looking at the watch, it was less than six o'clock. Lin Yi planned to take a bath before Uncle Fu came to deliver the meal.
So far, Lin Yi is still very satisfied with his current job and working environment. He gets the same treatment as living in a hotel every day and earns 30,000 yuan. Where can he find this job?
It's much more comfortable than helping the old man knit straw sandals at home.
"Xiao Shu, I feel a little regretful. This Lin Yi doesn't look like someone who can be my shield?"
Chu Mengyao changed into a set of home clothes and complained to Chen Yushu.
"Oh, I think he's fine."
Chen Yushu was lying on the bed, leaning her legs upside down against the wall. She didn't know where she had read that this could slim down her legs and promote growth.
"What's so good? Originally, I was thinking about finding a handsome guy to pretend to be my boyfriend. Now I think I'll find an old-timer and bring him out without being laughed to death!"
Chu Mengyao was so angry that she gritted her teeth: "If you like him, you can be his girlfriend."
"Oh, I'm not in trouble and don't need a shield. Otherwise, I might really think about it."
Chen Yushu shook his head and said.
"You have a powerful brother, who dares to provoke you? If I had a brother who could break a big tree with one kick, I wouldn't have to find any shield!"
Chu Mengyao knew that Chen Yushu was deliberately angry with her, but who asked someone to have a brother when she didn't?
"Sister Yaoyao, how about I ask my brother to find you a godbrother in the army?"
Chen Yushu blinked: "How about I love my brother... Then why doesn't Zhong Pinliang just stand aside obediently?"
"Xiao Shu!"
When Chu Mengyao heard what Chen Yushu said, it became more and more unreasonable, and her eyes widened in anger:
"What kind of bad ideas are you coming up with! You said before that you asked my father to find me a shield, but... look, who did you find? Can he be used as a shield? Now you have come up with such a stupid idea for me, why are you still in love with me? It's so ugly!"
"Oh, okay, okay, I won't say anything anymore."
Seeing that Chu Mengyao was really angry, Chen Yushu quickly closed her mouth and did not dare to say any more.
Indeed, it was she who gave Chu Mengyao the idea of finding a shield. As a result, the person she found was not what she wanted, and she also bears some responsibility...
When Uncle Fu came to deliver dinner, Lin Yi had just taken a shower and rummaged through his luggage, but he didn't even have any decent clothes.
ForestYi couldn't help but complain that the old man was really stingy, couldn't he buy himself a new dress?
It is estimated that if she wears these clothes, Chu Mengyao will still think of them as dirty clothes after going out, and she will not even be able to sit on the sofa.
No way, Lin Yi casually handed over the new image of Bao Lin Yi that Uncle Fu gave him, leaving both Chu Mengyao and Chen Yushu stunned!
Before, he was unkempt, wearing a torn vest and big trousers, but now after taking a shower, he looks elegant. Coupled with the school uniform, he looks completely different from the previous image of a migrant worker!
However, her first impression of Lin Yi was really bad, so Chu Mengyao would never admit that Lin Yi was a handsome guy. She could only say that he was better than before and more pleasing to the eye.
Uncle Fu brought four dishes and one soup, one with fish-flavored shredded pork, one with boiled fish, one with stir-fried cabbage, and one with spinach and roasted fungus. The soup is matsutake soup.
A combination of meat and vegetables, full of color and flavor.
Lin Yi hadn't had such a delicious meal for a long time. Seeing that Uncle Fu had also prepared his rice box, he happily took it and sat at the dining table.
Just as Lin Yi was about to move his chopsticks, Chu Mengyao was reluctant: "What are you doing? Xiao Shu and I haven't eaten yet, so you eat first? From now on, Xiao Shu and I eat first, and you eat the dishes we don't want to eat!"
